font.reason: Poster/impact display face for giant slogan words; single weight (no fake bold), heavy monoline strokes read well as hollow neon outline.

comps.translatedSummary: Three counter-flowing neon marquee rows: «بهتر» / «سریع‌تر» / «قوی‌تر» (BETTER/FASTER/STRONGER), outlined giant words, pulse cycling row by row, whole group fades out.

rtlDecisions.why: Rows 1 and 3 now move left (reading direction), row 2 moves right; counter-flow 'surround' feel kept.

rtlDecisions.what: Copy anchoring (left -> right edge) and bullet separator offset
rtlDecisions.why: First word of a row sits at the reading start; separator offset sign flipped to stay on the word's trailing (left) side.
Whole Persian words with ZWNJ before «تر»; letterSpacing 0; no fake weight 900; font size 300->330 (kit 1.1x).
Lalezar glyphs overlap at joins so text-stroke showed inner contours; replaced by SVG dilate-minus-erode outline of the same 5->8 px width, glow and opacity pulse unchanged.
Latin 0.92em/char estimate replaced by measured per-word width (em) so density is similar; unitW = width + 1.3em as designed.

rtlDecisions.what: Speeds 14/17/14, 45f pulse, 15f phase, 10/20f fades, colours, row order, glow
rtlDecisions.why: Motion design and light physics; vertical stack order is not reading-direction dependent.

concerns: The ZWNJ in «سریع‌تر» renders as a visible gap in Lalezar (non-joining), acceptable for display type.
